links.outcome: Model performance across internal and external cohorts and orthopedic subtypes
links.effect: Across internal and external cohorts, improved discrimination and precision-recall for all primary outcomes versus baselines; performance generalized across orthopedic subtypes.
links.quote: Across both internal and external cohorts, Ortho PeriFT enhanced discrimination and precision-recall for all primary outcomes compared to robust classical and neural baselines, reduced calibration error and negative log-likelihood, and maintained narrow uncertainty bands.

links.effect: Performance generalized across orthopedic subtypes with stable calibration across demographic strata (no numbers in abstract).
links.quote: Streaming analyses demonstrated earlier warnings at matched false alarm rates, and performance generalized across orthopedic subtypes with stable calibration across demographic strata.

links.outcome: Comparison against classical and neural baselines and clinician behavior
links.effect: Improved discrimination and precision-recall versus baselines; off-policy estimators show higher counterfactual utility than clinician behavior and behavior cloning.
links.quote: Off-policy estimators indicate higher counterfactual utility than clinician behavior and behavior cloning while ensuring zero-guardrail violations.

unlisted_practices: Guideline-aware action masks constraining recommended treatment titrations
Conformal risk intervals permitting model abstention when confidence is low
Prototype trajectory retrieval for case-based rationales

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of a multimodal transformer (Ortho PeriFT) incorporating explicit safety guardrails (guideline-aware action masks and conformal risk intervals for selective abstention) tested retrospectively across internal/external cohorts.

primary.practice: guideline-aware action masks and conformal prediction abstention
